stories.headline: JEPA research makes positive-view design central to alignment
stories.fact: Balestriero and LeCun prove representation alignment up to a rotation for separately trained JEPAs under their good-view assumptions. Their experiments find that positive-pair design can improve alignment efficiency beyond simply increasing model scale.
stories.inference: How training observations are paired may matter as much as encoder capacity.
stories.uncertainty: The theorem has assumptions; vision/language results do not establish financial prediction or trading performance.
stories.why: Compare causal market-view constructions at matched data and compute, with untouched temporal holdouts.
panels: Two observations of the same scene
Alignment up to a rotation under assumptions
stories.alt: Conceptual panels show two observations of one scene and alignment up to a rotation under JEPA assumptions.

stories.headline: Quant model identifies synchronized risk automation as a liquidation amplifier
stories.fact: Kohli’s calibrated agent-based model attributes market-wide liquidation amplification to synchronized risk overlays and execution. Dispersed overlay parameters, staged execution and a participation breaker reduce modeled tail liquidation when combined.
stories.inference: Diversifying model providers alone may leave common execution triggers intact.
stories.uncertainty: These are model-dependent simulations and historical replays, not an observed live-market causal estimate or guaranteed mitigation.
stories.why: Stress common-shock risk cuts; compare staged execution with identical hard risk limits and measure tail loss, shortfall and coverage.
stories.alt: Conceptual panels contrast common risk-cut triggers with staged execution and a participation breaker.

stories.headline: Early futures rebound precedes a busy election week
stories.date: Reuters November 2, 2026; snapshot 7:01 a.m. EST / 6:01 a.m. CST
stories.fact: Reuters reported Dow E-mini futures up 0.49%, S&P 500 E-minis up 0.46% and Nasdaq-100 E-minis up 0.74% at 7:01 a.m. Eastern, as technology shares steadied ahead of the midterms and earnings.
stories.inference: The early rebound does not establish durable post-open liquidity or a reversal of October’s weakness.
stories.uncertainty: This is a historical premarket snapshot, not a current executable quote. Cash trading began after this observation.
stories.why: Requote SPY/QQQ after the open and around data releases; validate depth and futures basis before sizing execution.
stories.credit: Reuters via StreetInsider; November 2, 2026, 7:01 a.m. EST.
stories.alt: Zero-based bars show early Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures changes of +0.49%, +0.46% and +0.74% at 6:01 a.m. CST on November 2.

stories.headline: Manufacturing and construction releases create a 9 a.m. execution checkpoint
stories.date: November 2, 2026 releases scheduled for 10:00 a.m. EST / 9:00 a.m. CST
stories.fact: The New York Fed calendar schedules ISM Manufacturing and construction data for November 2 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern, or 9:00 a.m. Central. Both results remain unavailable at this edition’s cutoff.
stories.inference: Simultaneous activity releases can change rate-sensitive features and execution conditions together.
stories.uncertainty: Calendar times are tentative; no release result, surprise or policy response is assumed.
stories.why: Record availability timestamps, separate release vintages and refresh spreads/depth after the data window.
stories.credit: New York Fed November calendar; checked November 2, 2026.
stories.alt: Two calendar panels show ISM Manufacturing and construction releases scheduled for November 2 at 9:00 a.m. CST; results unknown at cutoff.

stories.headline: Marvell agrees to acquire Lumentum in a fixed-ratio stock deal
stories.date: Company announcement November 2, 2026; agreement signed November 1
stories.fact: Marvell and Lumentum announced an all-stock acquisition agreement: each Lumentum share would receive 4.500 Marvell shares. The companies expect closing in the first half of 2028, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and other conditions.
stories.inference: The agreement combines electrical and optical AI connectivity; fixed-ratio consideration fluctuates with Marvell’s share price.
stories.uncertainty: The deal is not completed. Closing, integration and projected commercial benefits remain uncertain.
stories.why: Model the share ratio, dilution and closing conditions separately from AI demand forecasts; do not treat a headline deal value as fixed cash consideration.
stories.credit: Marvell/Lumentum joint release via Business Wire; November 2, 2026.
stories.alt: Deal terms show one Lumentum share exchanged for 4.500 Marvell shares, with completion pending approvals and conditions.
